integration.sun_path: Piecewise analytic exponential-height optical depth to top boundary; flat ground blocks downward sun rays.
integration.view_transmittance: Piecewise analytic exponential-height optical depth to each view sample.
integration.phase: Normalized Rayleigh; separate equation mirror uses 0.75 * normalized phase.
integration.note: CPU numeric study only; view scattering still uses midpoint quadrature.

candidate_definitions.normalized_phase_with_sun_reference: Normalized Rayleigh phase, analytic view transmittance, analytic sun-path transmittance.
candidate_definitions.cpu_evaluateFog_discrete_scattering_equa: C++ evaluateFog discrete view loop, source 0.75 Rayleigh phase and midpoint view attenuation; no sun-path transmittance. Omits final empirical horizon/fog blend and is not runtime parity.

limitations: Synthetic flat local fog medium; no planetary curvature or terrain shadow map.
Arbitrary world scale and sun radiance; no measured lighting calibration.
Scattering term only; omits the legacy renderer's additional empirical horizon/fog blend.
